subject: general
question:
Which of the following statements is/are correct?

Statements:

I) Electromagnet is a device used to convert magnetic field into electrical energy.

II) Electromagnet is a device used to convert mechanical energy into magnetic energy.
solution:
The correct answer is __**option 2**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• Electromagnets are devices that produce a magnetic field when an electric current passes through them.
 
• They do not convert magnetic fields into electrical energy.
 
• Electromagnets do not convert mechanical energy into magnetic energy; they convert electrical energy into magnetic energy.
